description: Defines the SELECT clause of the query. Use 'selectAll' for a 'SELECT *' query, otherwise provide a list of columns and functions in 'selectList'.

selectAll.description: When true, all columns will be selected (*). The selectList will be ignored.

distinct.description: Optional. When true, DISTINCT will be used.

selectList.description: One or more select items. This list is ignored if 'selectAll' is true.
